commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished original key-art painting for a class in Hollow Wake, a dark fantasy action RPG. Landscape 3:2, 1536x1024. Premium grounded cinematic realism, photorealistic CG with subtle painterly finish, weathered practical materials, wet stone, cold desaturated blue-grey shadows, deep blacks, volumetric fog, dramatic rim lighting, selective warm ember highlights, restrained grain. Match the visual family of a fiery dual-axe berserker, a hooded necromancer with skeletons and a lightning-calling sorcerer; no cartoon or anime. Compose one clear class-defining action and a distinctive silhouette. Place the adult hero at 62-68% from the left, head at about 30-40% image height, three-quarter body visible, large and readable on a phone. LEFT THIRD is dark, atmospheric low-detail negative space for website copy. Keep the face, important hands, weapons and companion within the central safe area, with generous headroom and nothing important at the outer edge. Cinematic environment fills the entire canvas, no studio background. No text, letters, logos, watermark, border, cards, collage, contact sheet or UI. Anatomically coherent hands and weapon grips. Restrained, believable magic rather than an all-over neon glow.
